beta.notes:
Fixes:
• Manually assigned unresolved work samples are copied into the workspace before staging cleanup, preventing their source files from disappearing.
• Crash reports redact email addresses and student names in known breadcrumb formats before upload. This does not remove every possible personal detail from free-form logs.
• The macOS installer now requires a verified native messaging bridge, with additional packaging checks for executable metadata and bundled libraries.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
